# `passportsim screenshot`

Capture the panel as a PNG artifact, optionally comparing it with an expected image.

| MCP tool | Scenario step | macOS | Windows | Browser |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `passport_screenshot` | `screen.save` | yes | yes | yes |

## Synopsis

```text
passportsim screenshot [view] [--compare-with <COMPARE_WITH>] [--inline] [--instance <INSTANCE>] [--max-diff-pixels <MAX_DIFF_PIXELS>] [--save-as <SAVE_AS>] [--tolerance <TOLERANCE>] [--json <@file|->]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Form | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `compare_with` | `--compare-with <COMPARE_WITH>` | `string` | no | Expected image, relative path. |
| `inline` | `--inline` | `boolean` | no | Return the image inline (false). |
| `instance` | `--instance <INSTANCE>` | `string` | no | Instance id. |
| `max_diff_pixels` | `--max-diff-pixels <MAX_DIFF_PIXELS>` | `integer` | no | Pixels that may differ (0). |
| `save_as` | `--save-as <SAVE_AS>` | `string` | no | Artifact label. |
| `tolerance` | `--tolerance <TOLERANCE>` | `integer` | no | Per-channel tolerance (0). |
| `view` | `<view>` | `"raw"` \| `"glass"` \| `"perceived"` | no | Which view (glass). |

A nested object or array is passed as one JSON document with `--json @<file>` or `--json -`; it has no flag of its own.

## Errors

`E_USAGE` (1), `E_STATE` (2), `E_LEASE` (6), `E_SECRET_REFUSED` (16), `E_INTERNAL` (17). What each means: [errors.md](../errors.md).

## Examples

### Capture what the panel shows

```sh
passportsim screenshot --json - <<'JSON'
{}
JSON
```

```powershell
@'
{}
'@ | passportsim screenshot --json -
```

### Capture what the firmware drew, ignoring the panel state

```sh
passportsim screenshot --json - <<'JSON'
{
  "save_as": "menu",
  "view": "raw"
}
JSON
```

```powershell
@'
{
  "save_as": "menu",
  "view": "raw"
}
'@ | passportsim screenshot --json -
```

### Compare against a golden, allowing no differing pixel

```sh
passportsim screenshot --json - <<'JSON'
{
  "compare_with": "golden/menu.png",
  "view": "raw"
}
JSON
```

```powershell
@'
{
  "compare_with": "golden/menu.png",
  "view": "raw"
}
'@ | passportsim screenshot --json -
```
